dict.string: Atria uses alarms only when you choose a wake time, so the phone can reliably alert you by that time even if the app is not open.
Atria can use the camera only when you choose to place a photo behind a share card.

With your permission, Atria reads Apple Health heart rate and sleep to check exported records and compare references, existing blood-pressure and sleeping-wrist-temperature records for reference availability, and optional nutrition and body mass for fitness context.

When you choose export and grant permission, Atria writes eligible heart rate, resting heart rate, HRV (SDNN), respiratory rate, active energy, cardio fitness estimates, workouts, and user-confirmed sleep to Apple Health.
Atria keeps a Bluetooth connection to your strap so heart-rate and motion can continue while the app is in the background.
Atria records your route, distance, pace, and elevation during an outdoor workout while the app is open. GPS recording pauses when you lock the screen or use another app.
Atria uses on-device motion context to avoid mistaking driving for a workout and to suggest walking, running, or cycling when the evidence is sustained.
Precise Location improves your outdoor workout route, distance, pace, and elevation while Atria is open. GPS recording pauses when the screen is locked or you use another app.
Atria can read the photo you choose only to place it behind a share card.
